P = int(input())
K = int(input())

SIZE = 1000010
MAXN = 1000000007

def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

def fast_exp_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

Parent = list(range(SIZE))
Rank = [1] * SIZE

def find_parent(nd):
    if Parent[nd] != nd:
        Parent[nd] = find_parent(Parent[nd])
    return Parent[nd]

def Union(nd1, nd2):
    if Rank[nd1] >= Rank[nd2]:
        Parent[nd2] = nd1
        Rank[nd1] += 1
    else:
        Parent[nd1] = nd2
        Rank[nd2] += 1

groups = set()

for i in range(1, P + 1):
    value = (K * i) % P
    Pa = find_parent(i)
    Pb = find_parent(value)
    if Pa != Pb:
        Union(Pa, Pb)

for i in range(1, P + 1):
    groups.add(find_parent(i))

if K == 0:
    ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P - 1, MAXN)
elif K == 1:
    ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P, MAXN)
else:
    ways = fast_exp_pow(P, len(groups), MAXN)

print(ways)
